GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Five Wide in straight. # Never a chance.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 1 length Four Wide turning, dropped off in Straight # always Wide

Jumped okay & Went Forward to narrow lead 2-3 Wide setling down, joined on inside at 1100m, Headed 1000m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing a head, stayed Two Wide rounding/exiting turn, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # weakened in str.
Jumped Ok drifted back to last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn under pressure. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3 Wide at 800m, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # Wide last 800m
Jumped Ok drifted back near last 4-5l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Raced wide and with cover in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to Turn then Hooked Out to 7 Lengths 3 Wide , Lost Ground in straight. (Tongue Tie ON) # never featured
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , pulled fiercely 1200m and Checked off heels, held together much same to turn then dropped off in Straight # no excuses

(Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages.] # never a threat
